[{"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 18, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Network Traffic Overview", "markdown": "## Network Traffic — Top Flows

Data stream: `logs-netflow.log-default`

**Key fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `source.ip` / `destination.ip` | Flow endpoints |
| `network.bytes` | Bytes per flow |
| `network.packets` | Packets per flow |
| `network.transport` | tcp / udp |
| `network.direction` | internal / external |
| `observer.ip` | Exporter (router/switch IP) |

**Top source IPs by bytes (last 1 h):**
```
POST /logs-netflow.log-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}},"aggs":{"top_src":{"terms":{"field":"source.ip","size":10},"aggs":{"bytes":{"sum":{"field":"network.bytes"}}}}}}
```

**Total flow bytes (last 24 h):**
```
POST /logs-netflow.log-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-24h"}}},"aggs":{"total_bytes":{"sum":{"field":"network.bytes"}},"total_flows":{"value_count":{"field":"flow.id"}}}}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 18, "w": 48, "h": 18, "i": "p2"}, "panelIndex": "p2", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Firewall Denies", "markdown": "## Firewall Deny Events

Data stream: `logs-cisco_asa.log-default`

**Key fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `cisco.asa.message_id` | 106023 = ACL deny, 113005 = auth fail |
| `source.ip` | Denied source |
| `destination.ip` | Target |
| `observer.hostname` | Firewall device |

**Recent denies (last 15 min):**
```
POST /logs-cisco_asa.log-default/_search
{"size":20,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"terms":{"cisco.asa.message_id":["106023","106001","113005"]}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-15m"}}}]}},"sort":[{"@timestamp":"desc"}]}
```

**Brute force scenario (asa.brute_force):** burst of 113005 from one source IP.
**Connection storm (asa.conn_storm):** 302013/302014 + 106023 spike on same firewall.

**Denies per minute trend:**
```
POST /logs-cisco_asa.log-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"cisco.asa.message_id":"106023"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}},"aggs":{"per_min":{"date_histogram":{"field":"@timestamp","fixed_interval":"1m"}}}}
```

Data stream: `metrics-snmp.device-default`

**Total active devices (last 5 min):**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-5m"}}},"aggs":{"by_vendor":{"terms":{"field":"device.vendor"}},"by_site":{"terms":{"field":"device.site"}},"total_devices":{"cardinality":{"field":"device.name"}}}}
```

Expected: 20 devices (8 HPE, 4 Dell, 8 Cisco), split 12 prod / 8 DR.

**Interface down events (ifOperStatus = 2):**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":10,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOperStatus.1":2}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}}}
```

Prod subnet: `10.10.0.0/16` | DR subnet: `10.20.0.0/16`

**Cross-site flows (last 1 h):**
```
POST /logs-netflow.log-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}},{"bool":{"should":[{"bool":{"filter":[{"prefix":{"source.ip":"10.10."}},{"prefix":{"destination.ip":"10.20."}}]}},{"bool":{"filter":[{"prefix":{"source.ip":"10.20."}},{"prefix":{"destination.ip":"10.10."}}]}}]}}]}},"aggs":{"bytes":{"sum":{"field":"network.bytes"}},"pairs":{"cardinality":{"field":"flow.id"}}}}
```

**VPN flap scenario (panw.vpn_flap + ios.intf_flap):** cross-site flow count drops to near-zero for ~20 min, then recovers.
Expected baseline: ~28 distinct src→dst pairs, ~50-200 MB/h cross-site.

Scenarios fire every ~3 h with seeded ±45-min offsets. Each window is visible as a spike/anomaly in the panels above.

| Source | Scenario | Signal | Data stream |
|--------|----------|--------|-------------|
| PANW | `panw.port_scan` | Burst of THREAT/deny from one external IP + NetFlow scan fan-out | `logs-panw.panos-default`, `logs-netflow.log-default` |
| PANW | `panw.vpn_flap` | VPN tunnel down/up + cross-site NetFlow drops to ~0 | `logs-panw.panos-default`, `logs-netflow.log-default` |
| PANW | `panw.malware_detect` | Spyware THREAT verdicts + C2-ish flow | `logs-panw.panos-default` |
| ASA | `asa.brute_force` | 113005 auth-failure burst from one IP | `logs-cisco_asa.log-default` |
| ASA | `asa.conn_storm` | 302013/302014 storm + 106023 denies | `logs-cisco_asa.log-default` |
| ASA | `asa.failover` | Failover syslogs | `logs-cisco_asa.log-default` |
| IOS | `ios.intf_flap` | LINK-3-UPDOWN + LINEPROTO pairs + NetFlow reroute | `logs-cisco_ios.log-default` |
| IOS | `ios.stp_reconverge` | STP syslogs + traffic dip | `logs-cisco_ios.log-default` |
| Meraki | `meraki.wan_failover` | MX uplink change event | `logs-cisco_meraki.log-default` |
| HPE | `hpe.port_saturation` | ifInOctets.1 spike near 100% util | `metrics-snmp.device-default` |
| Dell | `dell.mem_leak` | hrStorageUsed sawtooth climb | `metrics-snmp.device-default` |

See `docs/scenarios/` for full documentation of all 24 scenarios.
